what: Stage 2 Track A: the Stage 0 screen of the look ladder, before any render (STAGE2_PLAN 4 A.2-A.3; research_look 4.1 item 2)
note: prescribed references with perfect tracking on the round-two models; nothing adopted (P24)
method: Stage 2 Track A: the Stage 0 screen of the look ladder, before anyone looks at it (``STAGE2_PLAN.md`` section 4 A.2 and A.3; ``stage2/research/research_look.md`` 4.1 item 2 and Bottom line 3 and 4).
v040_rule: the gait the brisk_to_fr05 speed change passes through at 0.40 m/s: period, duty and lift mixed with the speed's weight (transitions.py)
limit_rule: over a drive limit (or a Stage 0 gate), a variant keeps its feature and loses that speed rung (character first) unless the owner decides otherwise

stage1_sources.rule: sha256 over designlab/stage1/*.py in path order, each file as its path relative to the package, a NUL byte, its bytes and a NUL byte

sources.inputs: look_refs.json (the ladder: specs, recorded prices and measures, each rung's arrays' sha256) and tail_phase.json (F9's phases), as committed; every rung's arrays (stage2/look/refs/, git-ignored) checked against the recorded sha256 before use (screen.load_arrays)
sources.limits: the record's drives (look.source -> stage1.refs.source: the body rebuilt from its record; design.act) at the record's bus: catalog.Actuator.sustained (0.57 x rated, A1), .peak (planning peak), .speed_at(bus) (servos: rated speed)
sources.tail_phase: screen.tail_phase: look.generate (V0 and V4 with other tails) or the rung's arrays, each read by screen.straight_run; the record check against round two's turning screen (runs.straight, runs.straight_brisk)
sources.straight_run: turning.inverse_dynamics(M, look.turning_traj(traj, M, q_home), mu 0.8, split 'exact', ds_friction=True): per foot turning._foot_stats over its single support (turning.summarize's single_support block), the stance pad's M_z and mu_req over every single-support frame, turning.ds_min_mu's min_mu over the double-support frames where no foot rolls
sources.drives: look.price (re-run) -> look.look_inverse_dynamics (accuracy r2) -> sizing._motor_space -> envelope._ratios: rms, peak (N m), speed (rad/s), cont_ratio = rms / sustained, peak_ratio = 1.25 peak / planning peak, speed_ratio = 1.15 speed / speed at the bus, worst
sources.passive: screen.passive_loads on look.look_inverse_dynamics' tau and omega: tau + b omega + f sign(omega) with the MJCF's joint damping b and friction loss f (the plant's: plant.model_files' MJCF, checked); its ratios equal look._passive_ratios'
sources.summary: gait.summarize on look.look_inverse_dynamics (round two's sizing summary): min_cop_margin, min_cop_margin_single, max_friction_ratio
sources.contact: look.price's contact block (look.look_inverse_dynamics; statics.cop, statics.support_margin) and look.measure's zmp_margin_min_mm (the multibody ZMP inside each frame's support hull, as look_refs.json records it)
sources.friction: screen.straight_run on the rung's trajectory (look.trajectory of its arrays), its rolling frames excluded from the double-support reading
sources.sway: screen.sway: stage0_pp_H = 2 x info.sway_amp / H (gait.generate's pendulum CoM path; round two's and Stage 1 G7's reading); com_pp_* from the arrays' model CoM (lateral peak to peak per stride, stage1.panels.sway's closed-loop reading); hip_mid_pp_H from the arrays' hip midpoint; trunk roll RMS from look.measure (recorded)
sources.accel: screen.accelerations: second differences of the arrays' model CoM over the periodic window (the window's x advance unwrapped, as look.measure); forward_lp1hz by stage1.metrics.lowpass (1 Hz, 2nd-order Butterworth, forward and backward; decision 10) on the window repeated; feet from the arrays' foot origins
sources.clearance: look.price's clearance block (look._clearance_gates: clearance.screen, gates r2, on the round-two MJCF) and look.measure's foot_below_floor_max_mm (recorded)
sources.plain_gait_id: gait.inverse_dynamics (accuracy r2; round two's split, a rolling foot's CoP kept in its flat pad box) -> sizing._motor_space -> envelope._ratios: each group's worst ratio, the governing ratio, those over 1 and the largest difference of any ratio from the screen's; F5 rungs only, informational
sources.over: look.price's over list: a drive ratio over 1, IK, the envelope's single-support CoP rule (-10 mm), the rolling split, a clearance gate
sources.over_with_passive: screen.passive_loads' ratios over 1 (outside Stage 0's rule; for the owner)
sources.cause: screen.peak_speed_cause: the joint's speed peak (look.look_inverse_dynamics' omega) per detected swing (look.contact_events), from 0.15 T before its lift-off to its touchdown, against the swing's duration
sources.look: look.measure, as look_refs.json records it (the features' measured amounts, context for the costs)
sources.vs_V0: screen.changes: the rung's value against V0's at the same body and speed
sources.g2: screen.g2: look.g2_hashes (stage1.refs.generate at r2, refs.write's npz) against the sha256 stage1/runs/2026-11-08/<body>/refs.json records, for nominal, brisk and fr05, on the code that ran the screen
